D/ [VALEN] S PF AVG ; R/ [GLORIA] ROMANORVM

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valens (364-378), possibly Arles mint, Emperor right, Reece period 19; possibly RIC vol. 9 page 64 no. 7(c), issue of 364-367, though diadem appears rosetted here and reverse looks irregular; flan is smaller than Ae 3 as listed. Obverse description: Bust ?rosetted diademed draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [VALEN] S PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor walking right dragging captive and holding labarum. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA] ROMANORVM. In exergue: [-]ON. Diameter: 15.8mm, Weight: 2.42gms, die axis: 6
